title: SHANG++: Robust Stochastic Acceleration under Multiplicative Noise
summary: Under the multiplicative noise scaling (MNS) condition, original Nesterov acceleration is provably sensitive to noise and may diverge when gradient noise overwhelms the signal. In this paper, we develop two accelerated stochastic gradient descent methods by discretizing the Hessian-driven Nesterov accelerated gradient flow. We first derive SHANG, a direct semi-implicit discretization that already improves stability under MNS.
